_help: Per robot: `code` keywords go to GitHub code search (model IDs work best: a bare 'TRON1' drowns in crypto repos, a bare 'TRON2A' matches 'synchrotron2a'); `text` keywords go to OpenAlex full-text search; `hf` keywords match Hugging Face repo names; `aliases` are the names that tag a hit with this robot in the report (whole-word, case-insensitive). arXiv only searches titles and abstracts, so it has its own raw query list under sources.arxiv.queries. `ignore_paths` is a regex: a repo whose every hit is in a matching file (news dumps, dated posts, data files, adopter lists) is left out. Add a robot by adding a block here. `repo` keywords match repository names and descriptions on Gitee, which has no code search.

arxiv._note: Checked 2026-11-11: all:LimX 8 hits in total (one is a 2010 maths paper matching 'lim x', hence cat:cs.RO), "TRON 1" 1, "LimX Oli" 5, "TRON 2" 0 for now. "Tron1", TRON1 and "sole-foot" have none, and generic terms such as "point-foot" or "wheel-foot" only bring other companies' robots (0 overlap with LimX), so they are left out. arXiv only indexes titles and abstracts: OpenAlex full text is the main paper source.

_models: Model IDs from LimX's own description repos: TRON1 = PF_/SF_/WF_TRON1A|B, plus PF_P441A..C2 (older point-foot TRON1, per tron1-robot-description); W1 = WL_P311D/E (wheel-legged quadruped, tron1-robot-description); Oli = HU_D04_01, HU_D03_03 (discontinued predecessor, humanoid-description); Luna = HU_L04_01 (luna-description); TRON2 = SFYG_TRON2A, DA_TRON2A (tron2-robot-description ships a generic robot.urdf). P1 and CL-1 have no public description repo, so only their names are searched. CL-1 is searched so a first project can be found, but the list has no CL-1 entry, robot page or form option yet: when one is listed, add CL-1 to ROBOTS in build_robot_pages.py, the README robot tables and the form. TRON2 code is also found by the names of LimX's TRON2 stacks people build on (tron2_env, tron2_rl_lab, TRON2_YG_LAB, tron2_openpi, tron2_mujoco_sim), since the description repo has no model ID.
